verdict: A clean, calm pause card with a clear lime primary and tidy lower-case type, but it reads as a generic pause menu: tiny in a black void, with no player context, no focus state, and chrome buttons that crowd out the pad-lost message.

findings.what: The card is about 480x485 px on a flat black 1920x1080 field. It fills roughly 7% of the screen, so it feels lost, and it breaks the guide's 'centred card at about 90% of screen' window rule. There is no scrim over the game and no sign of which player lost the pad.
findings.fix: Dim the live raid behind it with a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer instead of pure black. Either widen the card toward the window rule, or keep it small as a modal and add a context line: a 'p2' tag (16px f-cond, tx-2) above the title, or 'pad lost' with a 56px hero glyph.

findings.where: menu buttons (settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new)
findings.what: The screen's one job is to get the pad back. Four secondary actions of equal visual weight sit under the primary and push 'end run' far away. Feedback, what's new and report a problem are clutter on a disconnect prompt.
findings.fix: Keep reconnect, settings and end run. Move feedback, what's new and report a problem into settings, or shrink them to a 14px footer legend row. This cuts the card height by about 200px.

findings.what: The primary is lime-filled, but there is no pad glyph or live prompt naming the button to press (e.g. an A glyph). The text is also not clearly the 20px body size, and no focus ring or press state is visible on the other rows, so the pad focus path is unclear.
findings.fix: Add a 24px pad-button glyph left of 'reconnect'. Give every non-primary row a visible focus state: a 2px --acc border or a --ui-raised fill, plus a 3px lime left bar.

findings.what: The lime 2px top tab is only about 36px wide and dim and olive. It sits on the card corner and looks like a rendering artifact rather than a deliberate accent, because it has no relation to the title.
findings.fix: Brighten it to full --acc and align it with the title's left edge at x=760 (24px inset), or remove it.

findings.what: The 'pad lost' title is 32px, but the X is thin and grey (tx-2) and floats about 25px from the right edge. Its hit area is not visibly bounded. The title and X are not on the same optical baseline: the X center is at y~346 and the title center at y~349.
findings.fix: Make the X a 40x40 hit box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on focus. Centre it on the title's cap-height (y=349) and right-align it to the 760-1160 content column.

findings.what: Red text with no button container is a lone floating label 40px below the grid. Its tap and focus target is unclear, and the red is small (about 18px) on dark.
findings.fix: Make it a full-width 56px outlined button with a --danger 1px border and a 20px label. Separate it from the others with a 24px gap and a divider line.

findings.what: The vertical rhythm is inconsistent. The gap between title divider and reconnect is 24px, the button gaps are 16px, and the end-run gap is about 40px with 56px bottom padding. The two-up row has a 16px gutter, so it works, but the card's top padding (about 36px) and bottom padding (about 60px) are unequal.
findings.fix: Use 24px padding top and bottom, 16px between buttons, and 24px before the end-run row, all on the 8px grid.

findings.what: Black void, a grey card, a lime button: it could be any game's pause menu. Nothing says Pillagers or ARC-style hot-accent industrial.
findings.fix: Show the paused raid dimmed behind the card, and add a small player badge (p2 in its colour once the owner picks). Add a 14px version stamp footer in tx-2.
